events.txt: 🌍 Four humans wake in an untouched world: Eira, Ask, Embla, Torv. They know nothing — but they can observe everything. What will they create?
🔥 Embla rubbed sticks together until a spark caught the tinder — Embla's ember (Fire) has been invented! Warmth at night. Opens the path to pottery and smithing.
✨ From that day on, Embla was known as Embla the Firebringer.
❄️ The first winter has come. The world turns white and hard, and the nights grow long. Fire is no longer comfort — it is life.
🔪 Eira struck two stones together and kept the sharp shard — Eira's shard (Sharpened stone) has been invented! Faster gathering of everything.
🌿 Eira began believing the world repeats and can be understood — no one told them to. Others may follow. (The Knowing Eye)
events.label: A NEW WAY OF SEEING

events.txt: 🪢 Eira twisted grass fibers into something strong — Eira's twine (Rope) has been invented! Makes it possible to bind parts together.
🌸 Spring returns. The survivors count each other, and begin again.
👁️ Embla noticed that spilled seeds sprout where they fall. An idea begins to form.
🗡️ Eira lashed a sharp point to a long shaft — Eira's pike (Spear) has been invented! Humans are prey no longer. Deer can be hunted — food even in winter.
✨ From that day on, Eira was known as Eira the Spearmaker.
Ask taught Eira the secret of Embla's ember. The knowledge spreads.
🪓 Eira bound a hard edge to a wooden shaft — Eira's hewer (Axe) has been invented! Twice as fast logging. Required to build huts.
🌿 Eira began painting a mark on a flat stone when something new is made — no one told them to. Others may follow. (Painting a mark on a flat stone)

events.txt: Eira taught Torv the secret of Eira's shard. The knowledge spreads.
👁️ Embla noticed that grass fibers hold when twisted. An idea begins to form.
🛖 Eira raised logs against each other into a shelter — Eira's home (Hut) has been invented! Shelter and warmth at night. Three huts close together become a village.
🏹 Eira bent a young branch with a cord and felt it fight back — Eira's hunting bow (Bow) has been invented! The hunt no longer needs closeness. Deer fall at a distance.
🌸 Spring returns. The survivors count each other, and begin again.
🛞 Eira watched a log roll and understood something great — Eira's cartwheel (The Wheel) has been invented! The foundation of mills, carts — and everything that spins.
🛖 Eira built a hut.

👁️ Torv noticed that fire makes the heavy ore sweat metal. An idea begins to form.
👶 Ask and Eira have had a child, Liv — generation 2. They inherit traits from both.
🛖 Torv built a hut.
✨ From that day on, Torv was known as Torv the Founder.
🏘️ Three huts have become more — Torvstead has been founded! A village born of nothing but cooperation.
🌾 Torv let the wheel drive stones that ground grain — Torv's millhouse (Mill) has been invented! The village can process food — famine recedes.
🏺 Ask placed shaped clay in the fire and found it hard as stone — Ask's vessel (Pottery) has been invented! Food can be stored — hunger bites less.
👁️ Embla noticed that fire makes clay hard. An idea begins to form.
🧱 Embla built a stone chamber that gathered the heat of the fire — Embla's burnoven (Kiln) has been invented! Heat enough to melt what hides in ore and sand.
🌱 Embla pressed spilled seeds into turned soil and waited — Embla's tilling (Farming) has been invented! Food that returns every year. The village roots itself.
🌱 Embla the Firebringer has turned the soil — the valley's first field lies open to the sky.
⚒️ Embla watched gleaming metal run from the glowing ore — Embla's ironcraft (Iron smithing) has been invented! Metal — an entirely new material.
📜 Embla carved signs into clay so knowledge could outlive its owner — Embla's script (Writing) has been invented! Knowledge spreads to all — and to generations to come.
🐺 Wolves found Eira the Spearmaker alone in the winter night. Screams carried far across the snow.
🌱 Ask has turned the soil — a new field lies open to the sky.
⛏️ Embla forged the iron into an edge that never dulled — Embla's plough (Metal tools) has been invented! Three times faster work.
Ask taught Liv the secret of Ask's vessel. The knowledge spreads.
